description: Extracts structured fields from customer complaint forms (customer contact details, complaint nature, incident details, desired resolution).
note: analyzer.json is the single mutable source of truth, tracked by git. Each promoted version is deployed to Azure under a distinct analyzerId (lowercase, e.g. invoicev1) so multiple historical versions can be live and compared side by side. Run scripts/promote-analyzer.ps1 to deploy + record a new entry here.
